This is an ENTRY LEVEL role. 
ON-SITE - Cranberry Township, PA 

All Lines Technology is seeking a skilled and motivated Software Developer/Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing new software applications, supporting existing software products, and collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver high-quality technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to work on projects using Agile/SCRUM or iterative methodologies, contributing to the enhancement and maintenance of our software products.
Responsibilities:
Develop new applications and automations using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse), following team technical standards and meeting requirements.
Help design and build AI solutions, including Microsoft Copilot Studio agents and integrations that connect AI to business data.
Write and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures and data workflows on SQL Server and Azure SQL.
Build reusable reports and dashboards for management and business users with Power BI, and work with data tools such as SSIS, SSRS and Microsoft Fabric.
Connect business systems through APIs and data files (for example PSA/ticketing, ERP and HR platforms).
Gather requirements from clients and stakeholders, and turn business needs into working features that meet functional and performance expectations.
Support existing solutions: troubleshoot issues, handle change requests and keep systems running smoothly.
Write clean, well-tested, reusable and maintainable code that follows industry best practices.
Follow team standards for source control, peer code reviews, testing and deploying from development to production.
Write clear documentation, including deployment guides, user instructions and project case studies.
Work in Agile/Scrum or iterative delivery, contributing to sprint planning, status updates and project milestones.
Share knowledge with teammates and help build a collaborative team environment.
